'''Kelthizar Nimm''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] serving the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Entrus]]. He was used as a point of contact for operative wishing to connect with the [[Rebel Sector Command]] on the planet. Nimm's cover was as a [[dealer]] in the [[Tabal Comet]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]].
